answer: Think of each new agent as a sparrow landing on an island: it can sing at once, but its attestations only count after a 30-epoch vesting delay, and its earned stake stays locked the whole time. A sybil farmer who spins up 200 fake identities must fund and wait out 200 separate lockups before any vote matters, and if one is caught attesting junk, the locked orchard of rewards across that cluster is slashed. Patience becomes the price of fake scale.
